courses.title: Energy Healing: Single Session or 3 Pack
courses.description: An online energy healing session over Zoom, 30 to 60 minutes long, in a style Michael learned from Charlie Goldsmith and from trance-healing study with Eileen Davies. He tries a series of techniques while checking in with you as you go, with a follow-up check-in a few days later; it can be booked singly or as a pack of three.

flags: Borderline, kept: the session page sells 'energy healing that gets results', rating 'your current discomfort' 0 to 10 and aiming for 'the maximum possible relief', with a no-change-no-charge refund. It names no disease or condition, and both the page and his disclosure (https://www.mediummichaelmayo.com/energy-healing-disclosure) say it does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease and tell clients to keep up medical and mental-health care. A human may judge the results promise differently.
Price shown as '$150' / '150 US dollars' for a single session; the 3-pack price is not shown on the page.
The page's image is an Unsplash stock photo, so no image is given.
